7161ee1494a3: Draft or revise one verse · translationCore 4 Help
924f10cde3b8: Verse view is handy for small corrections and for translators who prefer to work one verse at a time.
2e916581c6b1: In Translate, click Verse in the switch above your translation.
3a741eaf2d05: For an empty verse, click its dashed Draft verse {n} button. For a drafted verse, click its text.
967d0e1e904d: Click Save verse, or click outside the editor.
c1b69e650e2b: To throw away your change, click Cancel instead.
66522b86c05a: The helps panel follows the verse you are editing.
c949d8f44bd1: To make a verse span, use Section view. See Make or break a verse span.
d40609f9c65f: A poetry verse opens with all its lines. Shift+Enter starts a new line; Tab and Enter save and close the editor. See Paragraphs and poetry.
